title: LoginResponse
description: EXPECTED schema for POST /auth/login response IF OrangeHRM's REST API v2 supported username/password token login. NOT CURRENTLY VALID: confirmed via direct curl testing that this endpoint returns HTTP 404 on the public OrangeHRM demo (opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com) — REST API v2 uses OAuth2 authentication, not a JSON token-login endpoint. This schema is kept for documentation purposes only, in case OrangeHRM adds a working token endpoint in future, or as a reference if pointing this framework at a self-hosted instance with OAuth2 configured. See AuthApiClient.login() for the corresponding test method, which asserts against the ACTUAL (404) response, not this schema. Real authentication in this framework uses cookie/session-based login via authHelper.ts's authenticateAdmin(), not a bearer token.

token.description: JWT bearer token — would be returned by a working token-login endpoint (none currently exists on this instance)
